name: Lizardfolk
summary: Cold, practical reptile-folk of the swamps. Lizardfolk see the world as food, threats and tools, and they think about feelings the way others think about weather.

age.summary: Lizardfolk mature at 14 and rarely live past 60.

size.description: Lizardfolk are a little bulkier and taller than humans.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.

features.name: Swim Speed
features.summary: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

features.name: Bite
features.summary: Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can make unarmed strikes with: 1d6 + STR piercing damage on a hit.

features.name: Cunning Artisan
features.summary: During a short rest you can carve a shield, club, javelin or darts from the bones and hide of a Small or larger creature you killed.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.summary: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.summary: You are proficient in two of these skills: Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth and Survival.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.summary: Without armor, your AC is 13 + your DEX modifier. A shield still works.

features.name: Hungry Jaws
features.summary: As a bonus action, make a special bite attack. On a hit you gain temporary hit points equal to your CON modifier (minimum 1). Once per short or long rest.
